description_en: Call the DescribeDynamicTagRuleList operation to query the rules for dynamic tags
description_zh: 调用DescribeDynamicTagRuleList接口查询智能标签的规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-dynamic-tag-rule-list --tag-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag-key tagkey1 --tag-value 0 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --dynamic-tag-rule-id 004155fa-15ba-466d-b61a-00000000000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDynamicTagRuleList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the tag
parameters.name: tag_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The tag key.

For more information about how to obtain a tag key, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145558.html
parameters.help_zh:
标签键。

关于如何获取标签键，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145558.html
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
The tag value.

For more information about how to obtain a tag value, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145557.html
parameters.help_zh:
标签值。

关于如何获取标签值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145557.html
parameters.name: tag_value

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Start value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Start value: 1. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

起始值：1。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dynamic tag rule

TagValue.description_en:
The tag value.

TagValueMatchFunction.description_en:
The method used to match the tag value. Valid values:

all

startWith: prefix

endWith: suffix

contains

notContains

equals
TagValueMatchFunction.description_zh:
标签值的匹配方法。取值：
all：全部。                        
startWith：前缀。
endWith：后缀。
contains：包含。
notContains：不包含。
equals：相等

MatchExpressFilterRelation.description_en:
The relationship between conditional expressions. Valid values:

`and`

`or`

Only one combination of conditions is supported
MatchExpressFilterRelation.description_zh:
条件表达式之间的关系。取值：

`and`：和。
`or`：或。

目前仅支持一种组合条件

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource

Status.description_en:
The status of tag sync to the application group.

`RUNNING`: The synchronization is in progress.

`FINISH`: The synchronization is complete
Status.description_zh:
标签同步到应用分组的状态。
`RUNNING`：进行中。
`FINISH`：已完成

TagValueBlacklist.description_en: The tag values that are not processed by the dynamic rule. When a user deletes a dynamic tag group, the tag values of the group are added to a blacklist. If a new resource is later added with a blacklisted tag value, a corresponding group is not created
TagValueBlacklist.description_zh: 动态规则不处理的TagValue。当用户删除动态Tag分组的时候，分组对应的TagValue会添加到黑名单；在之后有新的资源新增此TagValue时，不会创建对应的分组
